abstract: One hundred and forty six patients with advanced germ cell testicular tumours (38 seminomas and 108 malignant teratomas) treated by combination chemotherapy were studied over 10 years. Most of the improvement seen was in patients with malignant teratoma undifferentiated. In the most recently treated patients (1984-1987) 75% of drug resistant cases were malignant teratoma intermediate compared with 26% in the series treated between 1978-1983. The microscopic features of 52 primary testicular tumours were compared with features seen in excised retroperitoneal lymph nodes after completion of chemotherapy. Primary malignant teratoma intermediate had a higher incidence of viable malignancy in the excised tissue than malignant teratoma undifferentiated. Mature teratoma or fibronecrotic tissue within resected tissue was associated with a good prognosis. If resection was complete patients with drug resistant malignant teratoma intermediate had a more favourable prognosis than drug resistant malignant teratoma undifferentiated. It is advised that retroperitoneal node dissection should be considered in the management of patients with advanced germ cell testicular tumours, and that as complete a resection as possible be attempted to avoid the danger of missing residual disease.
abstract_ja: 進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者146例（セミノーマ38例、悪性奇形腫108例）を、併用化学療法で治療し10年間にわたり検討した。得られた改善の多くは、未分化型悪性奇形腫の患者で認められた。最近治療された患者（1984～1987年）では、薬剤抵抗性の症例の75%が中分化型悪性奇形腫であり、1978～1983年に治療された系列では26%であった。52例の原発性精巣腫瘍の顕微鏡的特徴を、化学療法完了後に切除された後腹膜リンパ節で見られた所見と比較した。原発性中分化型悪性奇形腫では、未分化型悪性奇形腫に比べ、切除組織で生存する悪性腫瘍が認められる頻度が高かった。切除組織内の成熟奇形腫や線維壊死組織は予後良好と関連していた。切除が完全であった場合、薬剤抵抗性の中分化型悪性奇形腫の患者は、薬剤抵抗性の未分化型悪性奇形腫の患者より予後が良好であった。進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療においては後腹膜リンパ節郭清を考慮すべきであり、残存病変の見逃しを避けるため、可能な限り完全切除を試みるべきである。
